content: Tarwa n Cam, Xam d Yafit
Ttwarwen asen-dd iḥenjiren awarni i sseḥřet. *
Ayt n Yafat tuɣa aten d Jumar, Majuj, Maday, Yawan, Tubal, Macik d Tiras.
Iḥenjiren n Jumar, tuɣa aten d Ackanaz, Rifat d Tujarma.
Iḥenjiren n Yawan tuɣa aten d Ilica, Tarcic d Ikittiyyen d Idudaniyyen.
Zzaysen i ttwabḍant tegzirin n řegnus di temmura nsen, kuř ijjen ɛlaḥsab iřes nnes uca marra ɛlaḥsab řaǧ nsen u di řegnus nsen.
Ayt n Ḥam tuɣa aten d Kuc, Miṣrayim, Fuṭ d Kenɛan.
Iḥenjiren n Kuc tuɣa aten d Seba, Ḥawila, Sabta, Raɛama d Sabtaka. Iḥenjiren n Raɛama tuɣa aten d Caba d Dadan.
Kuc ijja-dd Nimrud. Wanita ibda ad yiři d jjiheř di temmurt.
Wa tuɣa d anegmar d ameqqran zzat i wudem n SIDI. X uya qqaren: ‘Anegmar ameqqran am Nimrud zzat i wudem n SIDI.’
Amezwar n tgeldit nnes tuɣa atent d tineddam n Babil d Irix d Akkad d Kalna di temmurt n Cinɛar.
Zi temmurt nni dd-iffeɣ ɣar Accur uca ibna din Ninwa, Riḥubut-Ɛir d Kalaḥ
d Risin jar Ninwa d Kalaḥ, nettat d tandint tameqqrant.
Miṣrayim ijja-dd Iludiyyen, Iɛanamiyyen, Ilahabiyyen, Inaftuḥiyyen,
Ifatrusiyyen, Ikasluḥiyyen, inni zi dd-iqqarṣen Ifilisṭiniyyen, uřa d Ikafturiyyen.
Kenɛan ijja-dd Ṣidun, amenzu nnes, d Ḥit
d Uyabusi d Umuri d Ujirjaci
d Uḥiwi d Uɛarqi d Usini
d Urwadi d Uṣamari d Uḥamati. Awarni as mbezzɛent marra řaǧat n Kenɛan.
Tuɣa aymir n ayt n Kenɛan zi Ṣidun ɣar Xirar ař Ɣazza u ssenni ɣar Sadum d Ɛamurra d Adma d Ṣabuyim ař Lacaɛ.
Ina d ayt n Ḥam ɛlaḥsab řaǧat nsen, ɛlaḥsab iřsawen nsen, di timmura nsen u ak-d řegnus nsen.
I Cam, wenni d jedd n marra ayt n Ɛabir, umas n Yafat, ameqqran, ttwarwen as-dd ɛawed iḥenjiren.
Iḥenjiren n Cam tuɣa aten d Ɛilam, Accur, Arfakcad, Lud d Aram.
Iḥenjiren n Aram tuɣa aten d Ɛuṣ d Ḥul d Jatir d Mac.
Arfakcad ijja-dd Calaḥ u Calaḥ ijja-dd Ɛabir.
Ttwarwen-dd i Ɛabir tnayen n iḥenjiren. Ijjen qqaren as Falaj, minzi deg wussan nnes tᵉttwafeǧeq temmurt, u qqaren as i umas Yuqṭan.
Yuqṭan ijja-dd Almudad, Calaf, Haḍarmawt, Yaraḥ,
Haduram, Uzal, Diqla,
Ɛubal, Abimayil, Caba,
Ufir, Ḥawila d Yubab. Marra ina tuɣa aten d iḥenjiren n Yuqṭan.
Tammurt mani tuɣa zeddɣen tuɣa-tt zi Mica ař Safar, adrar n ccarq.
Ina d ayt n Cam ɛlaḥsab řaǧat nsen u ɛlaḥsab iřsawen nsen, di temmura nsen u ak-d řegnus nsen.
Tina d řaǧat n iḥenjiren n Nuḥ, ɛlaḥsab mammec dd-xeřqen, ak-d řegnus nsen. Zzaysen i zi ttwabḍan řegnus di temmurt awarni i sseḥřet. *

footnotes.text: Jumar- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘wenni břa řɛib’ niɣ ‘wenni ikemřen’. Majuj- niɣ ‘Maxux’, niɣ ‘Magug’.
Ikittiyyen d Idudaniyen- ixs ad yini ‘tiqebbař n Kit d Dudan’.

Xirar- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘amcan i inewjiwen’. Ɣazza- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘jjehd’. Adma- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘tammurt tazeggʷaɣt’. Ṣabuyim- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘iɣayḍen n wezɣar’ niɣ ‘aẓri n weẓri’ niɣ ‘iɛebbuzen’ niɣ ‘tandint n řɛeskar’.

Falaj- isem wanita ixs ad yini ‘abeṭṭu’ niɣ ‘afeǧeq’. tettwafeǧeq- awař-a izemmar ad iceyyar ɣar (1) ubeṭṭu n iwdan umi SIDI ibeṭṭa iřes nsen uca dewřen nitni ad ssiwřen ɛřam kuř iřsawen jar asen (xzar Amz. 11:1-9), niɣ ɣar (2) ubeṭṭu n umaḍal (niɣ ‘ddunnit’) deg iziynan, ixs ad yini Amrika, Ifriqiyya, Asiya, Ustraliya d Urupa, maɣar deg umezwaru tuɣa tammurt d ijj n wemcan (xzar Amz. 1:9, 10). Yuqṭan- isem-a wanita ixs ad yini ‘ameẓyan’.
